points.heading: Writing: letter names
points.summary: Name the letters of the alphabet in order, and match each capital letter to its small letter.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell common exception words and words with ff, ll, ss, zz, ck, nk and tch, add -s, -es, -ing, -ed, -er and -est, and use the prefix un-.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Join words and clauses with and, and use capital letters, full stops, question marks, exclamation marks and capital letters for names and I.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Understand stories and poems by discussing what happens, predicting what might happen next and making simple inferences, and enjoy rhymes.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Say out loud what they are going to write about, and sequence sentences to form short narratives.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell more common exception words, homophones, contractions and words with suffixes such as -ment, -ness, -ful, -less and -ly.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Join ideas with and, but, or, because, when, if and that, use commas in lists, tell statements, questions, exclamations and commands apart, and name nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Answer and ask questions about a text, retell events in order and predict what might happen next.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Plan or say out loud what they are going to write, and write narratives with a beginning, middle and end.

points.heading: Reading: word reading
points.summary: Apply knowledge of root words, prefixes and suffixes to read aloud and understand new words.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell words with suffixes, homophones and words from the Years 3 and 4 list, use the possessive apostrophe with plurals, and use the first two letters to find a word in a dictionary.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Choose a or an, express time and cause with conjunctions, adverbs and prepositions, and punctuate direct speech with inverted commas.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Draw inferences about characters' feelings, thoughts and motives, and predict what might happen from details given.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Organise writing into paragraphs around a theme, and use headings and sub-headings in non-narrative writing.

points.heading: Reading: word reading
points.summary: Apply knowledge of root words, prefixes and suffixes to read aloud and understand new words.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell further homophones and irregular plural possessives, and use the first three letters to check a spelling in a dictionary.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Use Standard English verb forms, fronted adverbials with commas, determiners, pronouns and conjunctions, and choose nouns or pronouns to avoid repetition.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Identify main ideas drawn from more than one paragraph and summarise them, and spot themes across stories.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Create settings, characters and plot in narratives, and improve writing by suggesting changes.

points.heading: Reading: word reading
points.summary: Apply knowledge of root words, prefixes and suffixes, including Greek and Latin roots, to read aloud and understand new words.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell words ending -able, -ible, -cious and -cial, homophones and words from the Years 5 and 6 list, and use the first four letters to find a word in a dictionary.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Use relative clauses, modal verbs, and brackets, dashes or commas for parenthesis, and make subjects and verbs agree.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Draw inferences and justify them with evidence from the text, and tell fact from opinion.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Identify the audience and purpose of writing, and choose the right form and vocabulary for it.

points.heading: Writing: spelling
points.summary: Spell words with suffixes after -fer and endings -ant, -ance, -ent and -ence, further homophones, and use hyphens after prefixes.

points.heading: Vocabulary, grammar and punctuation
points.summary: Recognise formal speech and writing, including the subjunctive, identify the subject and object, and use colons, semi-colons and hyphens.

points.heading: Reading: comprehension
points.summary: Summarise the main ideas across paragraphs, and explain how language, structure and presentation contribute to meaning.

points.heading: Writing: composition
points.summary: Link ideas within and across paragraphs with adverbials and other cohesive devices, and improve writing for its purpose.
